text_block_list.text:
Ah... Oops! Sorry,
Maya missed out on 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though. Just like you said,
Trainer-chan, I'll win next time.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
choice_data_list: Let's make it an even more fun race next time.
Maybe there are still some things you don't know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I hope it turns out to be a fun race.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe I'll try pushing myself
just a little bit more.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Besides, doing nothing but losing
isn't any fun at all, right!
